About me

Seller by night, student by day, builder in between

I'm Md. Abu Bokkor Siddik, known to most people as Dex. I work the night shift as a moderator for Beautyology, a Facebook live-sales page — answering customers, confirming orders and keeping live sessions selling smoothly from 6 PM to 3 AM.

Alongside that, I run my own online three-piece clothing business, selling across five Facebook pages, and handle order processing for skincare customers all over Bangladesh — verifying addresses, calculating delivery zones and preparing orders for courier dispatch.

I'm also a BBA student at BUBT (Bangladesh University of Business and Technology), now in my 2nd year — so everything I learn about marketing, law and economics in class gets tested the same night in a real business.
